newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Finance Ministry issues circular, ordering domestic firms to strengthen management of funds outside their budgets.

- Foreign banks have made a good start in the local currency business over the past two months. They are now involved in Chinese yuan loans, exchange of commercial papers and trading on the yuan interbank market.

- BUSINESS NEWS - A survey by the newspaper indicates 98.2 percent of Shanghai residents are excited about the Chinese takeover of Hong Hong, saying news reports about the takeover are their top interest at present.
- Commentary says China's inflation rate is expected to continue to move at low levels for the rest of this year.
